title: Stormlog Studio artifact block v1
description: The artifact block every artifact-scoped Studio document carries under the key artifact (design §5.1), written by contracts.artifact_block. Not a document of its own: it has no format or schema_version.

path.description: Root-relative POSIX path of the artifact.

index_id.description: Random per index build; a rebuild gives a new one.

generation.description: +1 each time the index takes in new lines.

size.description: File size in bytes at the last read; null when the file was never statted (failed: unreadable).

sha256.description: Of the whole file; null until all of it is consumed.

growing.description: The size changed within the last 5 s.

session_status.description: Status of the last infer.session record.

terminal.description: An infer.session record with a status other than running exists; false for a file with no session record.

origin_ns.description: Time zero of the artifact's plots: the first infer.session record's timestamp_ns, else the first client request's started_at_ns.

cut.description: The first line not indexed when a budget stopped the build (limits_hit has rows); bytes_read is its offset. null otherwise.

ns.description: Integer nanoseconds since the Unix epoch on the client's clock, written as a decimal string because JavaScript numbers lose integer precision above 2^53 (design §5.1). A missing value is null, never "0".

line_ref.description: contracts.LineRef: a 0-based line number, its byte offset, its length without the newline, and the SHA-256 of those bytes.
